supports: Bringing down costs for residents of Westchester and the Bronx
positions.quote: Using inclusion and openness as a foreground, he is fighting to bring down costs and make life easier for people in Westchester County and the Bronx.

source.title: About | Congressman George Latimer (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: Expect a focus on cost-of-living measures. His site doesn't name specific bills.

opposes: Cutting Medicaid to pay for tax cuts
positions.quote: President Trump and Congressional Republicans are working to cut Medicaid by nearly a trillion dollars to pay for tax-breaks for billionaires.

source.title: Health | Congressman George Latimer (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: He would vote against Medicaid cuts, which affect low-income residents, people with disabilities and nursing home residents. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

positions.quote: Latimer has worked with all stakeholders on key social justice reforms, including the Police Reform and Reimagining Task Force, banning Gay Conversion Therapy, signing the Anti-Wage Theft Law and the Wage History Anti-Discrimination Law among others.

source.title: About | Congressman George Latimer (official U.S. House website)

positions.impact: As Westchester County Executive he signed these local laws. Expect support for similar federal worker protections.
